name: Cowl of Languages
body:
Price 2,200 gp; Aura faint divination; CL 5; Weight 1/2 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This half length cloak of fine silk is adorned with embroidered swirling patterns. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to tell lies and a +1 bonus to caster level when casting enchantment (charm) spells.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,250 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, the creator has the ability to speak the five languages chosen, tongues
